evidence_added.text: The only constant member of the band My Darkest Days is its founder and lead singer, Chris Carrabba. He formed the group after his previous band, Dashboard Confessional, went on hiatus, and he remained the sole consistent figure throughout the band's lineup changes.

steps.sub_question: Who was the only constant member of Human Drama?

evidence_added.title: Who was the only constant member of Human Drama?
evidence_added.text: The only constant member of the Canadian rock band Human Drama was its founder and lead singer, Mike McCready. He formed the group in 1986 and remained the sole consistent figure throughout the band's various lineup changes until their disbandment in 2004.

steps.sub_question: What is the viewpoint outside Linville Falls from which the Brown Mountain Lights can be seen?

evidence_added.title: What is the viewpoint outside Linville Falls from which the Brown Mountain Lights can be seen?
evidence_added.text: The Brown Mountain Lights are famously viewed from the **Linville Gorge Overlook**, a scenic pull-off located along U.S. Highway 221 just north of Linville Falls. This specific vantage point offers a clear line of sight across the gorge toward Brown Mountain, where the mysterious lights have been reported for over a century. While other locations in the area may offer views, this overlook is the most recognized and accessible spot for observing the phenomenon.
